# Nell Harcourt

## Overview

- **Age:** Seventeen  <sub>[v3 c3 P7](../source/v03-c03.md#nw-v03-c03-p0007)</sub>
- **Gender:** Female  <sub>[v1 c12 P16](../source/v01-c12.md#nw-v01-c12-p0016), [v2 c20 P22](../source/v02-c20.md#nw-v02-c20-p0022)</sub>
- **Origin:** Nova Scotia  <sub>[v3 c3 P7](../source/v03-c03.md#nw-v03-c03-p0007)</sub>
- **Role:** Schoolteacher and writer  <sub>[v3 c31 P1](../source/v03-c31.md#nw-v03-c31-p0001), [v3 c36 P3](../source/v03-c36.md#nw-v03-c36-p0003), [v3 c36 P5](../source/v03-c36.md#nw-v03-c36-p0005)</sub>
- **Nicknames:** Nell-girl  <sub>[v3 c3 P17](../source/v03-c03.md#nw-v03-c03-p0017)</sub>

## Appearance

Nell is a tall young woman with a bright face, large starry gray eyes, fine features, and red or auburn hair. Her nose features seven prominent freckles that she has repeatedly tried to remove with lotion. She was once seen by unexpected visitors covered in white down and feathers after transferring a feather bed.

_Sources: [v1 c25 P0](../source/v01-c25.md#nw-v01-c25-p0000), [v2 c20 P17](../source/v02-c20.md#nw-v02-c20-p0017), [v2 c20 P20](../source/v02-c20.md#nw-v02-c20-p0020), [v2 c20 P22](../source/v02-c20.md#nw-v02-c20-p0022), [v3 c3 P7](../source/v03-c03.md#nw-v03-c03-p0007), [v3 c31 P1](../source/v03-c31.md#nw-v03-c31-p0001), [v3 c31 P3](../source/v03-c31.md#nw-v03-c31-p0003), [v3 c31 P4](../source/v03-c31.md#nw-v03-c31-p0004)_

## Personality

Nell is an imaginative, expressive, and talkative young woman who is quick to voice her feelings. She possesses a cheerful and philosophical nature, though she is prone to sudden surges of nostalgia, dramatic melancholy, and self-doubt. Deeply romantic and ambitious, she embraces life's small joys—such as feather-beds—and handles social discomfort with dignity and composure.

_Sources: [v1 c25 P1](../source/v01-c25.md#nw-v01-c25-p0001), [v1 c27 P11](../source/v01-c27.md#nw-v01-c27-p0011), [v2 c20 P23](../source/v02-c20.md#nw-v02-c20-p0023), [v3 c3 P7](../source/v03-c03.md#nw-v03-c03-p0007), [v3 c3 P9](../source/v03-c03.md#nw-v03-c03-p0009), [v3 c31 P7](../source/v03-c31.md#nw-v03-c31-p0007), [v3 c36 P13](../source/v03-c36.md#nw-v03-c36-p0013)_

## History

After being taken in as a child by Thirza and Obed Abernethy at Grey Shutters, Nell insisted that her name be spelled 'with an E' and swore eternal friendship with her neighbor Isolde Pembroke. During her school years, she participated in local rehearsals and concerts while enduring simple attire provided by Thirza. Desperate to get rid of her red hair, she purchased hair dye from an itinerant merchant, which disastrously turned her hair green. Obed later bought her a new dress to match her peers, and on another occasion, she had to rise to the situation and greet unexpected visitors while covered in feathers after transferring a feather bed. At seventeen, she left the Island with Hugh Carrow to pursue her education at Wexcombe in Portmaris, staying with the Harvey sisters alongside Honora Hollis. She subsequently took up a position as a schoolteacher at Coombe Road, lodging with Miss Thora Sweet at 'Wayside.' Soon after, she achieved literary success by selling a story sketch to 'The Youth's Friend' for ten dollars.
